situation_without_keyword_labels: The viewer sees help with a suitcase closure at the moment a ferry queue can move. The other passenger's handle grip makes assistance legible; the opening gate makes the action matter. Umbrellas and dock imply recent rain rather than relying on an unseen narrative.
artistic_strength: Face presence and an absorbed gesture lead; color/material contrast supports those relationships. The background has a coherent departure role rather than separate decoration.
precore_limit: The baseline is an authored plausible realization. It has no rendered-pixel proof and no user-acceptance proof. Suitcase buckle scale, scarf tails and personal bag fastening may be difficult in one native frame; no image has yet been called.
ownership_review: Only complex scene, reference-guided main subject, simultaneous visible relationships and face/hair guidance are mandatory evidence. Specific ferry story, gesture, count, garments and camera remain open.
